chapter.verse: Vantungah lamdang lian khat a kilang hi. Numei khat in ni silhin, kha in ama khe nuai-ah omin, aksi sawm leh nih a tuang kumpilukhu a lu tangah a khu hi.
Tua numei in tagai-in om a, tasuah ding natna nakpi-in tung a, kiko-in a om hi.
Tua tham loin, adang nalamdang khat vantungah kilang hi; gulpi san a lian mahmah khat hi a, lutang sagih leh kisawm a nei hi. A lute tungah kumpilukhu sagih a nei hi.
Tua gul in a mei tawh vantung aksi sehthum suah sehkhat kaikhia a, leitungah a khiat khit ciangin tasuak dinga kisa numei mai-ah ding-in ta a suah ciangin ne dingin a om hi.
Numei in mipawl khempeuh sik ciangkhut tawh a uk ding tapa a suah ciangin Pasian kiangah ahi zongin, ama tokhom kiangah ahi zongin kipaipih hi.
Tua numei in zong ni tul leh zanih sawmguk sung teng, vakin a kikhoi nadingin Pasian in a bawl kholhna gam lakah a tai hi.
Tua ciangin vantungah galkido-in, Mikhael leh ama vantungmite in gulpi tawh a kido uh hi. Gulpi leh a nungzuite in a do uh a,
A guallelh uh ciangin amaute in vantungah a om thei nawn kei uh hi.
Leitung khempeuh a kheem Dawimangpa, Satan kici tang lai gulpi pen ama nungzuite tawh leitungah a kikhiasuk hi.

Vantung pan nakpi aw khat in: “Tu-in eite Pasian’ gupna-a kipan vangliatna, gam leh ama Khazih’ ukna aana a hong tung zo hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, i ute i naute, i Pasian mai-ah sun tawh zan tawh a mawhsak mi in khiatsukna a thuak zo hi.
Amaute in Tuuno’ sisan hangin ahi zongin, amaute teci pan’ na hangin ahi zongin zoin, sihna thuak dongin a nuntakna uh haza lo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin vantungte leh vantungah a omte aw, nuam un! Leitung leh tuipi ahih uh leh, lunggimna a om hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Dawimangpa in hun tomkha bek ngah lai ahih thei-in, thangpaai mahmahin note omna-ah a paisuk zo hi!” ci-in a gen aw ka za hi.
Leitungah a kikhiasuk zo hi cih a theih ciangin gulpi in tapa suak numei a bawlsia hi.
Hun khat, hun nih leh hun lang sung teng amah vak nadingin ama omna gamlakah, tua gulpi kiang pan a suakta dingin leengin a tai theih nading muvanlai gol kha lang nih tua numei a kipia hi.
Gulpi in tua numei a taimang dingin ama kam sung pan a nungah gunpi bangin tui a suaksak hi.
Lei in numei huh a, gulpi in a kam sungpan a suahsak gunpi pen a kam ka-in a valh hi.
Gulpi in numei tungah heh mahmah a, Pasian’ thukhamte tham loin Zeisu’ teci pan’na a len numei’ suante lak pan a om laite tawh galdo dingin a paikhia hi.
